purpose: Hold the two research questions that sit next to the procurement pursuit decision surface behind the shipped product cards and behind explicit pre-registration. Research that is allowed to influence a shipping product before that product carries its own independent proof gets read backwards as justification for what shipped. This registry is the machine-checkable ordering gate: node tools/procurement_research_lane_gates.mjs --check fails while any prerequisite card's evidence is missing, or while a runnable lane's pre-registration file is missing or does not match its registered content hash.

prerequisite_cards.title: Provenance-safe opportunity window
prerequisite_cards.evidence_shards_note: This card shipped its evidence as a capture manifest only; it predates the per-card architecture evidence shard for this workstream. The manifest below is its independent proof.

lanes.title: Observed response-window length alongside procurement method, agency, certification posture, and award completion
lanes.question: Whether observed response-window length varies alongside procurement method, agency, certification posture, and award completion, stated as association only.
steps: Confirm the gate passes: every prerequisite card carries its own evidence, and this lane's pre-registration is registered by content hash.
Freeze the data vintage named in the pre-registration and take the field extract it specifies.
Apply the pre-registered exclusion rules before looking at any relationship.
Report associations with their sample sizes and their unknowns, in the pre-registered wording.
lanes.not_started_note: No analysis has been run. This card ships the gate and the pre-registration only.

lanes.title: Which solicitation fields are reachable without sign-in across agencies
lanes.question: For each examined solicitation field, whether it is accessible, authenticated, unavailable, or unstable across the procurement records already committed to this repository.
steps: Confirm the gate passes, as above.
Classify each pre-registered field from committed fixtures and committed data only, with no live retrieval of any kind.
Write the per-field, per-agency counts and the observation vintage to the classification file.
Where a field is authenticated or unavailable, say so in the handoff copy, with the last-observed date taken from the record.

lanes.title: Learned ranking of procurement opportunities
lanes.deferral_note: Deferred. No part of this lane begins here: no ranking model, no training data assembly, no scoring surface, and no pre-registration. The explainable preference set already shipped states why a matter qualified from rules the vendor stated themselves; a learned ranking would replace that stated reason with an unstated one, and nothing in this workstream yet carries the independent proof that would justify it. Reopening this lane is a separate decision, not a continuation of this card.
